verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Brevo supports API keys and OAuth 2.0 machine-to-machine credentials, plus IP allowlisting. Nothing documents permission scopes, per-key restrictions, or least-privilege credentials that could be issued for an agent. IP allowlisting is an adjacent network control, not privilege scoping, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
